messages:
Maria Chen: Quick async standup — launching the Slate campaign tomorrow AM. What I did: cleaned hero copy, pushed bench draft to /content/benchmarks, wired basic UTM tracking. Blockers: still waiting on final headshot from design and an OK on the benchmark numbers from analytics. Today: finalize ad copy, merge bench post, add redirect RFC for the landing URL and ping infra for CDN rule.

Sophia Patel: I have the headshot, uploading to the Marketing > Launch > Assets folder now. @Maria which crop do you want?

Maria Chen: Thanks! square 800x800 please. I can crop if needed but upload with the longest side = 1600 so we have flexibility.

Oliver Kim: Quick prod question — the landing redirect should be permanent (301) right? Also do we need query-string passthrough for campaign params?

Dan Rivera: Yes 301. Pass through UTM query strings, we rely on them for bench attribution. Also note: CDN needs a rule for the new /campaigns/slate path — add a short RFC comment and I can roll the rule during the 3pm deploy window.

Maria Chen: Will add RFC now — copying the minimal config here: ```
# CDN rule snippet (example)
path: /campaigns/slate*
action: forward
preserve_qs: true
status: 301
```

Sophia Patel: Bench post short checklist: update the graf with new numbers (I swapped in the latest 7-day RPS), check images alt text, confirm CTA link. I pushed a PR: https://git.redwood/marketing/bench-post/pull/42

Maria Chen: Reviewing the PR today. @Dan can you watch for any edge cases on query passthrough? I want to merge ~2:45pm so Dan has time for CDN change.

Dan Rivera: I can watch. If PR merges before 2:50pm I can stage the CDN rule and queue for 3:05pm deploy. After that, I'll validate the redirect and UTM passthrough.

deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: bench-post/main -> prod at 15:05 UTC (tenant: marketing) :rocket:

Oliver Kim: Small UI ask — can we make sure the hero image loads with priority fetch? otherwise CLS on the page. @Sophia can you add loading="eager" on the hero img in the PR?

Sophia Patel: Yep adding that now. Also updated alt copy per accessibility QA.

Maria Chen: Blocker cleared — got headshot. Final blocker is analytics sign-off on the bench numbers, @Dan any objection to the metric table?

Dan Rivera: Numbers look fine, just one nit on rounding, but ok to publish. No infra blockers.

Maria Chen: Awesome — merging PR in 10. Will post final launch checklist in #marketing when merged.

Sophia Patel: Great work team — I will schedule social posts once the page is live. :balloon:

Oliver Kim: ping me after deploy and I'll run a quick smoke on the redirect and pixel firing.

deploy-bot: deploy completed: bench-post/main -> prod at 15:06:18 UTC (status: success)

Maria Chen: Merge done. Posting final checklist in channel now. Thanks everyone! :tada:
